SELECT model.*, brand.id AS b_id, brand.NAME AS b_name, IFNULL( asset.assetNum, 0 ) AS assetNum FROM asset_model model LEFT JOIN asset_brand brand ON model.brand_id = brand.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT model_id, count( 1 ) AS assetNum FROM asset_asset GROUP BY model_id ) asset ON model.id = asset.model_id
and model.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.name}, '%')
and model.brand_id in
#{brandId}
and model.id in
#{id}
ORDER BY model.id

SELECT model.name AS model, brand.name AS brand, state.name AS state, type.name AS type, count( asset.id ) as total FROM asset_asset asset LEFT JOIN asset_state_conf state ON asset.state_id = state.id LEFT JOIN asset_type_conf type ON asset.type_id = type.id LEFT JOIN asset_model model ON model.id = asset.model_id LEFT JOIN asset_brand brand ON model.brand_id = brand.id GROUP BY model.id, state.id, type.id
